simple.meaning: מְעוֹנָה (mᵉʻôwnâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “den, habitation, (dwelling) place, refuge.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 10 times across Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, Song of Solomon, Jeremiah, and 3 more, beginning at Deuteronomy 33:27. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְעוֹנָה (H4585).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְעוֹנָה (mᵉʻôwnâh) / H4585 is traced through Deuteronomy 33:27, Job 37:8, Job 38:40, Psalms 76:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H4585. meonah מְעֹנָה noun feminine id.; — 1 den, lair of wild beasts: of מְעֹנָתוֺ כְּפִיר, Amos 3:4 , so plural absolute מְעוֺנוֺת Job 38:40 (|| סֻכָּה ), suffix מְעוֺנֹתָם Psa 104:22 ; construct אֲרָיוֺת מְעֹנוֺת Song 4:8 ; מְעֹנֹתָיו Nahum 2:13 (|| חֹרָיו ; of אַרְיֵה , figurative of Nineveh); of חַיָּה in General, תִשְׁכֹּן בִּמְעוֺנֹתֶיהָ Job 37:8 (|| אָ֑רֶב ); so apparently figurative of men, hunted by מְעוֺנוֺתֵינוּ ׳י, Jer 21:13 , figurative also of ׳י dwelling in temple, singular suffix, בְּצִיּוֺן מְעוֺנָתוֺ Psa 76:3 (|| סוּכּוֺ ). 2 figurative קֶדֶם אֱלֹהֵי מְעֹנָה Deut 33:27 the ancient God is a dwelling-place (for his people; compare I. מָעוֺן 3 ).
definitions.rootNote: or מְעֹנָה ; feminine of 4583 , and meaning the same

occurrences.englishText: The eternal God is your dwelling place.
when they crouch in their dens,
There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow,
The sun rises, and they steal away,
Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley,
Will a lion roar in the thicket,

“Behold, I am against you,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword will devour your young lions; and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will no longer be heard.”
I said, “Just fear me. Receive correction, so that her dwelling won’t be cut off, according to all that I have appointed concerning her.” But they rose early and corrupted all their doings.
